changes: Keep an immutable optimistic user/attachment snapshot in visible history. On inference failure, immediately surface the original error and release only that send's gate, then replace history with persisted IDs if recovery succeeds. Retain the fallback if storage fails; discard unpersisted partial/empty assistant output.

Use view revisions and request ownership to reject obsolete loads/callbacks, resume active sessions across navigation and prevent cleared turns from reappearing. Clears affect their own session; new submitted prompts retain input and wait for the clear. Clear-time loads select the requested view and read only after the clear settles.

Edits share the owned send lifecycle through truncation and replacement, so navigation cannot abandon an edited prompt after deletion. No preview read delays saving the replacement. Reject pending/missing edit identities with retained input until authoritative reload; a confirmed successful clear permits a queued edit to start the new conversation.

Only the state engine and its test file change. The suite has 36 state-engine tests: 33 new regressions and 3 existing cases, including a strengthened repository-timeout regression. Coverage includes persisted failure, failed reload, prior turns/attachments, identical prompts, retry/restart, stale reads/callbacks, ownership, navigation/clear queues, edits and missing identities.
